decisive_items: hypertrophy of the left thigh, overgrowth of both feet, and syndactyly of the second and third toes on the right
Dilated, tortuous veins were noted over the chest and left leg
response.rationale: Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome is defined by capillary malformation, venous varicosities, and limb overgrowth, all present here; lymphangiomas are a known associated feature but do not explain the full triad.

rejected.why: Only accounts for the lymphatic masses on MRI, missing the characteristic capillary malformation, venous dilation, and limb hypertrophy that define KTS.
